reuse.why: No shared category selection existed to reuse, and the change does not create one; it extends the existing per-action SQL and the copyPreviousMonth JS check in place, and setZero gets yet another copy of the hidden-filter query.

duplication.why: The skip rule (hidden, hidden group, saved template) is now written five times: four copies of the same SQL WHERE clause (setZero newly copied from the average actions) plus a JS version in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: Changes stay in server/budget/actions.ts where the month-wide actions live, but the rule is embedded in each action's query rather than in one place in that module.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, getBudgetData's select, and a test are touched.

maintainability.why: Any further change to which categories month-wide actions skip must be repeated in five spots in two languages (SQL and JS), which is exactly what the follow-up requirements would hit.

disguised_duplication.where: The rule is duplicated openly (identical SQL clauses in setZero/set3MonthAvg/set6MonthAvg/set12MonthAvg, and a JS equivalent in copyPreviousMonth), not disguised.

one_place.where: actions.ts: the goal_def/hidden exclusion is added separately to the SQL of setZero, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg, set12MonthAvg and to the JS condition in copyPreviousMonth.
